call_points.text: Medium to long-term Conductor EBITDA margin guided at ₹35,000–₹36,000 per MT plus tailwinds.
Targeting 10% YoY volume growth in Conductors and 25% YoY growth in Cables.
Supplied $15 million worth of cables across 3 major data center projects in the US.
Middle East war disrupted Oil exports in March and April due to freight spikes and supply chain halts.
Q4 PAT included ₹31 Cr non-operating items; excluding them, operating PAT grew 14% YoY to ₹285 Cr.
High metal prices will increase interest costs as working capital funding requirements rise.
Short-term demand slowdown expected due to higher metal prices, elevated freights, and war premiums.
Conductor Division 12M FY26 new order inflow reached ₹11,450 Cr, up 24.2% YoY.
Conductor Division pending order book stands at ₹7,671 Cr with 38.9% export mix.
Cable Division pending order book reached ₹1,800 Cr.
Q4 PAT had one-off impacts; excluding them, PAT would have grown 14% YoY in Q4.
Conductor EBITDA per MT increased to ₹44,919 in Q4 FY26 from ₹41,430 in Q4 FY25.
12M FY26 consolidated revenue rose 23.3% YoY to ₹22,902 Cr, hitting an all-time high.
Conductor pending order book stood at ₹7,671 crore with an export mix of 38.9%.
New order inflow for conductors in 12M FY26 reached ₹11,450 crore, up 24.2% YoY.

timeline.summary: Kushal N. Desai (Promoter-Chairman, MD & CEO) and Chaitanya N. Desai (Promoter-MD) declared no encumbrance on APAR Industries shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4).
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of ₹60 per equity share (₹241.01 crore total) on May 28, 2026, pending AGM approval.
Apar Industries reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹6,603 Cr (+26.7% YoY) and 12M FY26 revenue of ₹22,902 Cr (+23.3% YoY).
Apar Industries released its corporate presentation for May 2026, highlighting FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹22,902 Cr.
Apar Industries Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call held on May 28, 2026, via its website.
Apar Industries hosted its Q4FY26 concall detailing a ₹1,500 Cr FY27 capex plan and US data center expansion.
Apar Industries corrected the distinctive number range for equity shares allotted under its ESAR Plan 2024.
Apar Industries reported Q1FY27 results with record revenue of ₹6,591 Cr, up 29.1% YoY, and PAT of ₹467 Cr, up 77.7% YoY.
